# MedicineNet

> > MedicineNet is a doctor-produced medical information and health resource platform providing comprehensive disease guides, medication references, wellness content, and health news.

MedicineNet offers evidence-based health information covering diseases, conditions, medications, and lifestyle wellness topics. The site combines medical reference materials with interactive educational tools and current health news from leading research institutions.

## Key Topics

- Cancer
- Heart Disease
- Ulcerative Colitis
- Psoriasis
- Kidney Disease
- Shingles
- Hypertension
- Anxiety/Panic Disorders
- Allergies
- Alzheimer's
- Cardiovascular Health
- Medical Research
- Wellness
- Doctor-Produced Content
- Symptom Checker

## Medical Reference Indexes

- [Diseases & Conditions Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/diseases_and_conditions/article.htm): Comprehensive browsable index of diseases and conditions with medical reference material
- [Medications Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/medications/article.htm): Drug reference index covering prescription and OTC medications with dosing and interactions

## Disease & Condition Guides

- [Signs of Cancer in Women: Symptoms You Can't Ignore](https://www.medicinenet.com/womens_cancer_symptoms_pictures_slideshow/article.htm): Medical education guide on cancer symptoms in women with diagnostic imaging information
- [Psoriasis Types, Images, Treatments](https://www.medicinenet.com/psoriasis_symptoms_treatment_pictures_slideshow/article.htm): Medical slideshow on psoriasis types, symptoms, causes and topical treatment options
- [Ulcerative Colitis Symptoms, Causes, and Treatment](https://www.medicinenet.com/ulcerative_colitis_pictures_slideshow/article.htm): Medical guide on ulcerative colitis and inflammatory bowel disease symptoms and treatment

## Health News & Research

- [Listening to Music for 24 Minutes May Ease Anxiety, Study Finds](https://www.medicinenet.com/listening_to_music_for_24_minutes_may_ease_anxiety/news.htm): Health news article on music therapy research for anxiety relief from Toronto Metropolitan
- [Too Much Smartphone Use Linked to Disordered Eating in Teens](https://www.medicinenet.com/too_much_smartphone_use_disordered_eating_in_teens/news.htm): Health news on teen eating disorders linked to smartphone usage from King's College study
- [Belly Fat Linked To Heart Failure Risk](https://www.medicinenet.com/belly_fat_linked_to_heart_failure_risk/news.htm): Health news on cardiovascular risk from belly fat based on American Heart Association research
- [Ultra-Processed Foods Linked To Heart Attack, Stroke, Cardiac Arrest](https://www.medicinenet.com/ultra_processed_foods_linked_to_heart_problems/news.htm): Health news on cardiac risk from ultra-processed foods based on JACC Advances study
- [Women More Likely To Survive Cancer Than Men — At A Cost](https://www.medicinenet.com/women_more_likely_to_survive_cancer_than_men/news.htm): Health news on gender disparities in cancer survival and treatment side effects from Adelaide
- [Shingles Vaccine Protects Heart Failure Patients From Heart Attack, Stroke](https://www.medicinenet.com/shingles_vaccine_protects_heart_failure_patients/news.htm): Health news on shingles vaccine benefits for heart disease prevention from UC-Riverside study

## Wellness & Healthy Living

- [Health & Living: Information on Living a Healthy Lifestyle](https://www.medicinenet.com/health_and_living/focus.htm): Wellness guide covering diet, fitness, weight management, and healthy lifestyle topics

## Interactive Health Tools

- [Health TopicsHuman Body Quiz](https://www.medicinenet.com/human_body_quiz/quiz.htm): Interactive human anatomy quiz covering body systems and health education
- [Kidney DiseaseKidney Disease Quiz](https://www.medicinenet.com/kidney_disease_quiz/quiz.htm): Interactive kidney disease quiz assessing knowledge of kidney function and symptoms

## Optional Resources

- [MedicineNet Homepage](https://www.medicinenet.com): MedicineNet homepage offering doctor-produced health information and medical resources
- [Picture of Cauliflower Ear](https://www.medicinenet.com/image-collection/cauliflower_ear_illustration/picture.htm): Medical illustration of cauliflower ear with sports injury and trauma information
